title: QFoldAgent：用于蛋白质结构预测的自主量子优化多智能体系统
summary: QFoldAgent是一个闭环多智能体框架，用于5残基四面体晶格折叠。设计智能体提出序列条件惩罚，VQE量子经典管道优化哈密顿量，反馈智能体利用能量景观诊断和MolProbity验证信号改进惩罚。在QDockBank基准上，中位RMSD从3.64Å降至3.20Å；在未见序列上，结构有效性从87.5%提升至98.7%，恢复87%的初始无效案例。
summary_en: QFoldAgent is a closed-loop multi-agent framework for 5-residue tetrahedral-lattice folding. A design agent proposes sequence-conditioned penalties, a VQE-based quantum-classical pipeline optimizes the Hamiltonian, and a feedback agent refines penalties using energy-landscape diagnostics and MolProbity validation. On QDockBank, median RMSD drops from 3.64Å to 3.20Å; on unseen sequences, structural validity rises from 87.5% to 98.7%, recovering 87% of initially invalid cases.
